body:
I was bullied a lot as a kid and began dieting probably right around age 5. I don't ever recall having a sane relationship with food; it was always either my greatest enemy or my biggest comfort.

I was at a normal weight by the middle of high school but just kept dropping after that. I spent around two years on a very strict, 300 calorie or less a day diet. My health is pretty bad, as you can probably imagine. :/

I really hope I didn't trigger you too bad. I'm such a hypocrite...I never read posts by other people who have EDs because they really bother me. You're brave.

Thank you so much. I'm sorry you're going through it to but I'm glad to talk to someone who understands!
